descriptionChirho: Noun שְׂעֹרָה (se'orah): the cereal grain barley, one of the seven species of the Land of Israel, used for food, animal feed, and offerings. S143136 covers standalone and articular forms ('barley', 'the barley'), while S143137 covers conjunctive occurrences ('and barley'), often paired with wheat in lists. All translations converge: eng 'barley/and-barley', spa 'cebada/y-cebada', hin जौ/और-जौ, arb شَعير/وَشَعِيرًا, kor 보리/그리고-보리, swa shayiri/na-shayiri. The split is purely syntactic (presence of conjunction waw), not semantic.
